stranger_reading.guideText:
[ x ]
WELCOME — HERE IN ONE BREATH
What am I looking at? A small creature: a real CT-scanned macaque skeleton — 25 bones, about half a million triangles — standing in a physics world. The faint copy is its saved pose.
What does it do? It obeys real gravity: it falls, settles, and reacts when pressed. The numbers on the right are the engine's own. One thing is a labeled mock: sliding to the marker (walking is not real yet — the page says so while it happens).
What do I press? Any key below does one thing — start with 1: send the creature to the ring marker. Or click the creature to press on it (300 N).
Objective: send the creature to the ring marker — press 1.
stranger_reading.objectiveText: objective: carry to the marker · 1.20 m to go (mock carry)

keyRows.text: [1] send the creature to the marker (labeled mock)
[3] THE FALL TEST (real — watch it fall and rise)
[R] restart the world back to the standing start
[SPACE] press the creature (300 N, front-most point)

fall_verdict: THE FALL (real): running — the engine is integrating…
